key_findings: Low maternal licking/grooming increased formalin early-phase pain behavior in male mouse offspring.
TRPV1 and MrgprB4 mRNA were elevated in lumbosacral DRG of offspring of early-weaned dams; CGRP and TRPA1 unchanged.
